resources.string: This phone runs your Tinder for the Date dashboard. Date reads the screen, swipes and types in Tinder only while the switch below is on.
Code from the Phone screen on the dashboard
Date needs the accessibility switch to read what is on the screen and to tap, swipe and type in Tinder. Turn on Date in the list that opens.
Lets Date read what is on the screen and tap, swipe and type in Tinder for you, while the switch in the Date app is on. Date sends what it reads to your own Date server and nowhere else.
Keeps the phone linked to the person\'s own Date server so it can carry out the Tinder actions they asked for from their dashboard while the phone is in their pocket.
Date can use this phone while its switch is on.
